Detail_lesson: Provide examples of practices your team uses to promote a healthy work-life balance.
CustomInstruction: Name a practice you protect and the business pressure it regularly loses to. Honesty about that is more useful than a policy list.

Category: Strive to be Earth’s Best Employer
Title: Supportive Leadership
Detail_lesson: Discuss how supportive leadership in your team has positively impacted employees.
CustomInstruction: Describe something a leader did for someone on your team, and what it made possible.

Category: Strive to be Earth’s Best Employer
Title: Employee Recognition
Detail_lesson: Explain your approach to recognizing and celebrating employee achievements.
CustomInstruction: Name what your team recognises publicly and what goes unrecognised. The second list says more.

Category: Strive to be Earth’s Best Employer
Title: Empowering Teams
Detail_lesson: Describe practices your team employs to empower individuals and foster autonomy.
CustomInstruction: Describe a decision you handed over completely, and how you resisted taking it back.

Category: Strive to be Earth’s Best Employer
Title: Listening to Employee Feedback
Detail_lesson: Share how you effectively gather and respond to employee feedback to improve workplace satisfaction.
CustomInstruction: Trace one piece of employee feedback to a change people can see. If nothing traced, say what stops it.

Category: Strive to be Earth’s Best Employer
Title: Creating Positive Workplaces
Detail_lesson: Discuss ways your team has proactively created a positive and motivating workplace.
CustomInstruction: Name the thing about working on your team that people mention unprompted when they leave.

Category: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility
Title: Ethical Growth
Detail_lesson: Describe how your team integrates ethical considerations into growth and scaling strategies.
CustomInstruction: Name a growth option you did not take and the reason. Ethics is legible in the things you declined.

Category: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility
Title: Social Responsibility
Detail_lesson: Share how your team proactively engages in social responsibility initiatives.
CustomInstruction: Describe the commitment, the hours or money behind it, and who benefits. Say how it survives a bad quarter.

Category: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility
Title: Environmental Stewardship
Detail_lesson: Explain how your team prioritizes environmental stewardship as part of operational decisions.
CustomInstruction: Name one operational decision where environmental impact was actually weighed, and what it changed.

Category: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility
Title: Community Impact
Detail_lesson: Provide examples of positive impacts your team has made in your community through responsible growth.
CustomInstruction: Describe the impact and how you would know if it were real rather than reported.

Category: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility
Title: Responsible Decision Making
Detail_lesson: Discuss your team's approach to making responsible decisions aligned with long-term sustainability.
CustomInstruction: Give the question your team asks before a decision that could affect people outside the company.

Category: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility
Title: Long-term Sustainability
Detail_lesson: Explain practices your team employs to ensure long-term sustainability as it scales.
CustomInstruction: Name something you built to last that would have been faster to build otherwise, and the argument that won.

Category: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility
Title: Stakeholder Accountability
Detail_lesson: Discuss ways your team maintains accountability to diverse stakeholders.
CustomInstruction: Name a stakeholder with no formal power over you, and how they still hold you to account.

Category: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility
Title: Corporate Citizenship
Detail_lesson: Describe your team’s practices that exemplify strong corporate citizenship.
CustomInstruction: Describe a practice you would be comfortable seeing reported accurately in the press, and one you would not.

Category: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility
Title: Balancing Growth with Values
Detail_lesson: Explain how your team effectively balances growth ambitions with maintaining core values.
CustomInstruction: Name the value that costs you growth, and the last time it actually did.

Category: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility
Title: Transparent Leadership
Detail_lesson: Share how transparent leadership practices have positively influenced your team's success and responsibilities.
CustomInstruction: Describe what your leadership shares that it does not have to, and what became easier once it did.

Title: Visionary Goal Setting
Detail_lesson: Describe how you have set visionary goals that significantly expanded your team’s aspirations.
CustomInstruction: State the goal in one sentence and say what it would take to be wrong about it. Big goals need a falsifiable shape.

Title: Scaling Ambitions
Detail_lesson: Give an example of scaling a small idea into a significant organizational initiative.
CustomInstruction: Describe the first version and the tenth. Say what made scaling possible rather than just desirable.

Title: Expanding Boundaries
Detail_lesson: Explain a situation where your team expanded boundaries to achieve extraordinary outcomes.
CustomInstruction: Name the boundary — a market, a constraint, an assumption — and what you did to test whether it was real.

Title: Encouraging Bold Ideas
Detail_lesson: Share practices you use to encourage your team to propose bold and ambitious ideas.
CustomInstruction: Describe what happens to a bold idea in your team in its first week. That is the whole answer.

Title: Breaking Conventional Limits
Detail_lesson: Discuss an instance where challenging conventional limits led to exceptional results.
CustomInstruction: Name the convention, why it existed, and what you found when you ignored it.

Title: Innovating with Ambition
Detail_lesson: Describe how ambitious innovation significantly differentiated your team's outcomes.
CustomInstruction: Describe the ambitious choice and the safer one you rejected, and how the difference showed up in the outcome.

Title: Long-Term Strategic Thinking
Detail_lesson: Provide an example where long-term strategic thinking helped your team achieve a substantial goal.
CustomInstruction: Name the decision you would make differently on a three-year horizon than a three-month one, and which you actually took.

Title: Encouraging Big Thinking
Detail_lesson: Share your methods for actively encouraging big thinking within your organization.
CustomInstruction: Give the specific prompt, format or forum you use, and one idea that came out of it that you would not have had.

Title: Ambitious Problem Solving
Detail_lesson: Describe a significant problem your team solved by adopting an ambitious mindset.
CustomInstruction: Describe how the ambitious framing changed the approach, not just the target.

Title: Scaling from Small Beginnings
Detail_lesson: Explain how a small project your team undertook scaled significantly due to ambitious thinking.
CustomInstruction: Name the small thing and what it grew into, and the moment someone decided to bet more on it.
